facebookresearch_ccnet/cc_net/tools/dl_c.download_cc100_corpus: download the CC100 corpus to an output directory using multiprocessing for parallel shard extraction

facebookresearch_ccnet/cc_net/tools/expa.sample: sample sentences from Common Crawl data based on perplexity scores relative to a trained language model
facebookresearch_ccnet/cc_net/tools/expa.mine: mine sentences from Common Crawl shards that are similar to a given corpus using perplexity threshold filtering
facebookresearch_ccnet/cc_net/tools/expa.normalize: normalize a corpus text file by applying text normalization rules and writing output to a directory
facebookresearch_ccnet/cc_net/tools/expa.ExtractSentences: extract unique sentences from documents and score them with a language model using perplexity

facebookresearch_ccnet/cc_net/tools/make.load_dmoz_tags: parse a DMOZ RDF file and return a dictionary mapping URLs and domains to topic tags
facebookresearch_ccnet/cc_net/tools/make.add_tags_to_url: add or intersect DMOZ topic tags for a given URL in the url2tags dictionary
facebookresearch_ccnet/cc_net/tools/make.review_make_corpus: review the make_corpus function that filters documents by DMOZ tags and writes fastText-labeled output
